categories.name: Bài 2: Common Words & Spelling Traps (Bẫy chính tả & Từ vựng)
categories.description: Kho 70 từ vựng và bẫy chính tả kinh điển thường xuyên xuất hiện trong Part 1 & 2.

items.full_tts: Wednesday. We meet every Wednesday at nine.
February. The course starts in February.
items.trap_note: 80% thí sinh quên chữ 'r' đầu tiên: Feb-ru-ary.

items.full_tts: Tuesday. The museum is closed on Tuesday.
items.trap_note: Hay nhầm thứ Ba (Tuesday) và thứ Năm (Thursday).

items.full_tts: Thursday. Submission deadline is Thursday afternoon.
Saturday. A guided tour every Saturday morning.
August. The festival takes place in August.
items.trap_note: Viết hoa chữ A đầu, đuôi -ust.

items.full_tts: October. Applications close in October.
Autumn. Beautiful golden leaves in autumn.
items.trap_note: Chữ 'n' ở cuối là âm câm nhưng bắt buộc phải viết: Au-tumn.

items.full_tts: Accommodation. Does the price include accommodation?
items.trap_note: Bắt buộc 2 chữ 'c' và 2 chữ 'm': ac-com-mo-da-tion.

items.full_tts: Environment. We need to protect the natural environment.
items.trap_note: Hay quên chữ 'n' ở giữa: envi-ron-ment.

items.full_tts: Government. A grant from the local government.
items.trap_note: Hay quên chữ 'n' ở giữa: govern-ment.

items.full_tts: Restaurant. A table reservation at the Italian restaurant.
items.trap_note: Đuôi là -ant chứ không phải -ent: res-tau-rant.

items.full_tts: Necessary. Bring only the necessary equipment.
items.trap_note: Một chữ 'c' và hai chữ 's': ne-ces-sa-ry.

items.full_tts: Apartment. Renting a two-bedroom apartment.
items.trap_note: Chỉ 1 chữ 'p': a-part-ment (hay nhầm với 2 chữ p).

items.full_tts: Cafeteria. Lunch is available at the cafeteria.
items.meaning_vi: Quán ăn tự phục vụ, căng tin

items.full_tts: Corridor. Walk straight down the main corridor.
items.meaning_vi: Hành lang (Rất hay gặp trong sơ đồ Map Part 2)

items.full_tts: Exhibition. An art exhibition in the gallery.
Reception. Please check in at the reception desk.
Auditorium. The speech takes place in the auditorium.
Cloakroom. Leave your heavy coats in the cloakroom.
items.meaning_vi: Phòng gửi áo khoác / hành lý (Part 2)

items.full_tts: Balcony. A beautiful sea view from the balcony.
Separate. Keep personal items in separate bags.
items.trap_note: Chữ 'a' ở giữa: sep-a-rate (thường viết nhầm thành e).

items.full_tts: Dormitory. Staying at the student dormitory.
Questionnaire. Please fill out this short questionnaire.
Maintenance. Routine building maintenance on Friday.
items.trap_note: Dù động từ là 'maintain', danh từ viết là 'main-ten-ance'.

items.full_tts: Terraced. Living in a traditional terraced house.
items.meaning_vi: Nhà liền kề (Kiểu nhà phổ biến ở Anh)

items.full_tts: Definitely. I definitely want to attend that workshop.
items.trap_note: Chữ 'i' ở giữa: de-fi-nite-ly (không phải de-fi-nate-ly).

items.full_tts: Secretary. Contact the departmental secretary.
Privilege. Free admission is a special privilege.
Occurrence. Severe storms are a rare occurrence.
items.trap_note: Hai chữ 'c' và hai chữ 'r': oc-cur-rence.

items.full_tts: Equipment. Modern diving equipment is provided.
items.meaning_vi: Trang thiết bị (Danh từ không đếm được)

items.full_tts: Discipline. Sports help develop self discipline.
Laboratory. Research conducted in the science laboratory.
Temperature. The average daytime temperature in summer.
Parallel. Two parallel railway tracks.
items.trap_note: Một chữ 'r' và hai cặp 'l': par-al-lel.

items.full_tts: Guarantee. A two-year money-back guarantee.
Schedule. Here is the bus schedule for weekends.
items.trap_note: Người Anh phát âm /ˈʃedʒuːl/, viết là S-C-H-E-D-U-L-E.

items.full_tts: Millennium. Built to celebrate the new millennium.
items.trap_note: Hai chữ 'l' và hai chữ 'n': mil-len-ni-um.

items.full_tts: Leisure. The local council leisure centre.
Basement. Storage units located in the basement.
Lobby. Meet the group in the hotel lobby.
Foyer. Refreshments are served in the theatre foyer.
Gymnasium. Basketball training in the gymnasium.
items.trap_note: Dạng đầy đủ của gym: gym-na-si-um.

items.full_tts: Courtyard. An open courtyard with a stone fountain.
Canteen. Hot meals are served daily in the staff canteen.
items.trap_note: Hai chữ e ở cuối: can-teen.

items.full_tts: Pavilion. The cricket players gathered by the pavilion.
items.meaning_vi: Gian đình, lều lớn thể thao

items.full_tts: Aquarium. Tropical fish display at the marine aquarium.
Planetarium. Stargazing session at the city planetarium.
Monument. A memorial monument erected in the town square.
Roundabout. Take the second exit at the roundabout.
Furnished. A fully furnished one-bedroom flat.
Unfurnished. The house is completely unfurnished.
Microwave. The kitchen includes a modern microwave oven.
Dishwasher. Save time by using the electric dishwasher.
Refrigerator. Store fresh produce in the refrigerator.
items.trap_note: Re-frig-er-a-tor (chữ g, không có d; khác với fridge).

items.full_tts: Homestay. International students prefer living in a homestay.
items.meaning_vi: Ở cùng nhà dân bản xứ

items.full_tts: Bungalow. A single-storey bungalow with a private lawn.
Radiator. The bedroom radiator can be adjusted manually.
items.meaning_vi: Lò sưởi nước nóng trong phòng

items.full_tts: Wardrobe. A spacious built-in wooden wardrobe.
Locker. You will receive a key to your personal locker.
items.meaning_vi: Tủ đồ cá nhân có khóa

items.full_tts: Receptionist. Working part-time as a hotel receptionist.
Lifeguard. Qualified lifeguard on duty at the beach.
items.meaning_vi: Nhân viên cứu hộ bể bơi/bãi biển

items.full_tts: Volunteer. Looking for volunteer helpers this weekend.
Caretaker. The school caretaker maintains all facilities.
Gardening. Weekend gardening club activities.
Pottery. Evening classes in clay pottery making.
Photography. Learn digital landscape photography.
Backpack. Pack water and sunscreen in your backpack.
Helmet. Wearing a safety helmet is mandatory for cyclists.
Compass. Navigate through the woods using a map and compass.

fifty. A group of fifty students.

sixty. An entrance fee of sixty dollars per couple.
seventeen. Only seventeen seats remaining.
seventy. Seventy percent discount on second items.
eighteen. Only persons aged eighteen and over.
eighty. Approximately eighty percent of participants.
nineteen. Flight nineteen from Sydney has landed.
ninety. The hall seats ninety spectators.
one hundred and fifteen. Room one hundred and fifteen.
items.trap_note: Người bản xứ thường lướt 'one hundred and fifteen'.

items.full_tts: one hundred and fifty. Approximately one hundred and fifty visitors.
three hundred and fourteen. Dial extension three hundred and fourteen.
items.trap_note: Số đuôi teen trong số 3 chữ số.

items.full_tts: three hundred and forty. The flight distance is three hundred and forty miles.
My mobile number is 0 7 9 4 6, 0 9 2 8 1 7

items.trap_note: Số 0 thường đọc là 'oh' thay vì 'zero'.

items.full_tts: You can call us on 0 2 0, 7 9 4 6, 0 1 9 2
items.trap_note: Nhịp ngắt 3-4-4 chữ số quen thuộc.

items.full_tts: Please reach our office at 0 1 6 1, 4 9 6, 0 3 4 5
items.trap_note: Số 0 đọc 'oh', đọc tách từng con số.

items.full_tts: Contact the Edinburgh branch on 0 1 3 1, 4 9 6, 0 8 7 2

items.meaning_vi: Số di động Úc (bắt đầu bằng 04)
items.trap_note: Mã di động Úc gồm 10 chữ số.

items.full_tts: The total fee is forty-five pounds fifty.
items.trap_note: Người bản xứ thường nói 'forty-five pounds fifty' (bỏ chữ pence).

items.full_tts: Standard admission is seventeen pounds fifty.
The parking fee for the day is eight pounds seventy-five.
items.trap_note: Nghe số thập phân và mệnh giá tiền.

items.full_tts: A single bus fare is three pounds sixty.
A refundable deposit of two hundred and fifty pounds.
items.trap_note: Người nói hay lướt 'two hundred and fifty'.

items.full_tts: The annual club membership is one hundred and twenty pounds.
The monthly rent per room is three hundred and seventy-five pounds.
Course tuition fee is four hundred and fifty pounds.
A security bond of eight hundred and fifty pounds.
The full semester costs one thousand two hundred pounds.
items.trap_note: Có thể nói 'twelve hundred pounds' hoặc 'one thousand two hundred'.

items.full_tts: Special student discount price is twenty-four pounds ninety-five.
The evening buffet is thirty-nine pounds fifty per person.
The coach leaves at a quarter past seven in the morning.
items.trap_note: 'Quarter past' là qua 15 phút (7:15), 'Quarter to' là kém 15 phút (6:45).

items.full_tts: The tour concludes at a quarter to four in the afternoon.
items.trap_note: A quarter to four = 3:45 (nghe four nhưng viết số 3).

items.full_tts: Registration opens at half past ten sharp.
